text: The wave 4 journey harness runs in the test environment from Day 1 against stubs generated from the published contracts of rwb-debtsale, rwb-writeoff, rwb-partner, rwb-deviation, rwb-integration, rwb-payment, rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-decision and rwb-access, replaces each stub with its real owner as that owner's wave 4 story lands, fixes the business date at 2027-04-30 with the write-off cut-off month 2027-04, seeds one synthetic portfolio through the owners' published operations only, and writes one evidence report per run keyed by story and business date with the contract version of every hop and an all-green wave gate.
why: No source read specifies the harness environment, the seed and its identifiers, the fixed business date, the composite route paths, the evidence format and retention, or the gate name and thresholds, and the wave cannot wait for them without an agreed default.
read: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01/DP-03/DP-05/DP-11/DP-13/DP-18/DP-19, R5.6, R5.7 rule 6, R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 3, 20, 38, 41, 42, 43, 44 and 46; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 22 to 26 and 28; Program v4 section 8
confirm: Integration lead and QA lead at the wave 4 entry check
impact: The harness can be built and run against the stub set from Day 1 and swapped owner by owner; only the real environment, the agreed seed and the gate sign-off wait for the wave entry check, and a late change to them changes the harness code and the report, not the story's criteria.
